title: Nashville Teal Door
description:
Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay. A quiet neighborhood, just minutes from the airport and downtown Nashville. 3 bedrooms, 1.5 bathroom with new beds and a full kitchen. Beautifully redone cottage that is the perfect getaway for the entire family.

The space
The house has 3 bedrooms with 2 queen beds and 1 bunk bed setup. It comfortably sleeps 4-6 people. There is one full bathroom and 1 half bath in the master bedroom. The living room has 2 couches and the kitchen has a small table as well as an island. The TV is a smart TV with access to Netflix, HBO Max, Prime, etc. The kitchen has a stove, oven, microwave, fridge, ninja blender, toaster, and keurig. There is a washer and dryer, as well as an ironing board. There is parking for 2 cars in the driveway as well as free parking in front on the street.

Guest access
There is a front and a back door, both with keyless door pads. The front entrance is preferred for ease of use.

Other things to note
This house is approved by the city of Nashville for short term rental and has passed all the codes and inspections.
